name: @oh-my-pi/animations
description: The oh-my-pi animation plugin suite — ambient animated TUI plugins (both waves) as a single config-driven package.

omp.name: oh-my-pi animations
omp.description: Ambient animated TUI plugins (both waves) as a single config-driven package.

animations.description: Shared motion tier for all animations (each still gates to 'off' on non-TTY/CI/NO_COLOR). Default 'subtle' is the curated native posture; each shipped animation mounts as a separate ambient row.

auditTrailBoxPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Audit Trail Box mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

auditTrailBoxAccentColor.description: Audit Trail Box's primary accent — the box badge (the per-status risk ramp stays fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

breathingBorderPlacement.description: Reserved for a future Breathing Border placement override — its aboveEditor placement is currently hardcoded in the widget's controller, so this setting has no effect yet.

breathingBorderAccentColor.description: Reserved for a future Breathing Border accent override — the widget's palette is currently fixed, so this setting has no effect yet.

cacheMeterPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Cache Meter mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cacheMeterAccentColor.description: Cache Meter's primary accent — the badge color (the invalidation alert stays fixed error-red). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cadenceEqualizerPlacement.description: Reserved for a future Cadence Equalizer placement override — its belowEditor placement is currently hardcoded in the widget's controller, so this setting has no effect yet.

cadenceEqualizerAccentColor.description: Reserved for a future Cadence Equalizer accent override — the widget's palette is currently fixed, so this setting has no effect yet.

palimpsestPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Palimpsest mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

palimpsestAccentColor.description: Palimpsest's primary accent — the ember-tier glow at 4+ overlapping touches (underline/amber stay fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

rateLimitTidepoolPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Rate-Limit Tidepool mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

rateLimitTidepoolAccentColor.description: Rate-Limit Tidepool's primary accent — the water color (the near-empty sand alarm stays fixed warning-amber). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

reflectionRipplePlacement.description: Reserved for a future Reflection Ripple placement override — its aboveEditor placement is currently hardcoded in the widget's controller, so this setting has no effect yet.

reflectionRippleAccentColor.description: Reserved for a future Reflection Ripple accent override — the widget's palette is currently fixed, so this setting has no effect yet.

toolConstellationPlacement.description: Reserved for a future Tool Constellation placement override — its belowEditor placement is currently hardcoded in the widget's controller, so this setting has no effect yet.

toolConstellationAccentColor.description: Reserved for a future Tool Constellation accent override — the widget's palette is currently fixed, so this setting has no effect yet.
